request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

ONE GREEN FARM FIELD photographed in one wide shot, with four animals spread across it from left to right at slightly different distances: a black-and-white COW with its head down EATING grass; a brown HORSE RUNNING fast in side view, legs in mid-stride; a pink PIG standing on the grass; a white woolly SHEEP standing on the grass. The same grass and the same sky run behind all four animals. No people, no other animals. This is ONE single continuous photograph taken with one camera from one position: NOT a collage, NOT a grid, NOT side-by-side panels, no seams or dividing lines; the same ground and background run continuously behind every subject, and the subjects stand at slightly different distances from the camera like in a real scene. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
